caption:
Cut out the bad, but it keeps creeping back? You left the space empty. (1 Timothy 6:11 devotional)

Fleeing the bad is only half of faith. If the emptied space isn't filled with something Christ-shaped, the old things move back in. So don't just look at what you cut off — look at what you're running toward.
